title: EID1 blockade potentiates immunosurveillance against cancer metastasis via FPR1-mediated DC-NK crosstalk.
snippet: Metastatic disease remains the primary cause of cancer mortality, yet the identification of robust therapeutic targets is hampered by tumor heterogeneity and microenvironmental complexity.
